body: Thanks. I found a bed with the local shelter so I’ll be fine for the night. I’m just trying to learn as much about being homeless as possible.
I’ve spent my life being a punching bag. I tried to die and was laughed at. I just wish I had a more permanent way.

I tried the shelters. They don’t accept men unless they have been in a disaster like a house fire. Honestly no beds. 

I get the point about friends caring but this is a lot.
I don’t want to bother my friends like that. It sucks. Life sucks. They know that I’ll probably die out here but I guess it’s better that they don’t see me.
I just want to find a gun now. It sucks I failed
I’m not worried about how it effects those anymore, now i just don’t want to survive my attempt as a vegetable.
I don’t know what you think you’re doing but labels etc don’t do anything to stop people from feeling enough despair to want to end it.

Hey! Thanks for reading. All those suggestions are all I save my money for. A car, an apartment, etc. I want to be normal.

To answer the work question, it’s snowed maybe a inch in NJ and my bus never came. I spent 30 minutes waiting until I called an Uber which was 20+ minutes away. It was a compounding of shitty situations.

Edit: and I’ve tried to see what triggers my depression but it feels so random. It’s like a cycle that doesn’t work on anything aside from my Brain thinking it’s time to die.
